title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add a dedicated place to hang robes and towels with this wall mount robe hook, crafted from brass and made to coordinate with the Malibu collection.

  • Wall mount installation helps save bathroom floor space
  • Contemporary design that suits transitional bathroom hardware
  • Brass construction for a sturdy everyday hook
  • Color-coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Assembled in the USA

Specs

  • Category: Robe Hooks
  • Collection: Malibu
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 2 in L x 2 in H x 2.64 in W
  • Projection: 2.64 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 0.5 lb
  • Screw size: 6
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finish options to help match other versatile bath accessories in the Malibu collection.

_previous.title: Malibu Robe Hook
_previous.description: The contemporary minimalist look of the elegant Malibu collection has timeless appeal. The Malibu Robe Hook is constructed of the finest solid brass materials to provide a sturdy hook for your robes and towels. The hook is finished with our designer lifetime finishes to provide unparalleled performance and durability.
